scope: Selected allele-specific functional and clinical examples; not a comprehensive variant–phenotype database. Case-level evidence does not automatically transfer to other variants or cell subtypes.

phenotypes.label: Reduced forced expiratory volume in one second
phenotypes.rationale: FEV1 is measured in the stated CF genotype cohort; the trial does not attribute every respiratory feature to this allele alone.

evidence.claim: G551D protein response supports potentiation of a channel gating defect; missense classification alone would not establish this mechanism.
Randomized participants with at least one G551D allele had a 10.6 percentage-point FEV1 advantage over placebo through week24. The other allele and disease background remain relevant.

cases.cells: Epithelial CFTR activity is implicated; this trial does not identify a single atlas epithelial subtype responsible for the endpoint.
limits: Functional response does not generalize to all CFTR variants.
FEV1 is a directly measured phenotype in the variant-selected trial cohort. The clinical outcome does not establish variant-specific cell-type causality or cellular rescue.

cases.variantLabel: Patient-specific SVA retrotransposon insertion in MFSD8 intron6
cases.disease: CLN7 neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis, compound-heterozygous case

phenotypes.label: Seizure
phenotypes.endpoint: Seizure frequency and duration, including EEG
phenotypes.rationale: Seizures were measured in one affected patient; this is case evidence rather than proof that this allele alone determines the phenotype.

evidence.claim: Patient fibroblast RNA and functional assays supported correction of aberrant splicing and lysosomal dysfunction.
The uncontrolled individual-treatment report described reduced seizure frequency and duration.
A single case and fibroblast rescue do not establish reversal of neurodegeneration or rescue in an atlas-defined neuronal subtype.

cases.cells: Functional rescue was tested in patient-derived fibroblasts; direct human neuronal rescue was not demonstrated.
limits: No exact ClinVar variation match is asserted for the reported insertion.
Genomic coordinates and full insertion sequence are not normalized here.
The second allele and treatment timing matter; a truncating-variant label is not sufficient for splice-correction eligibility.
